needs_human.note: os.utime in _ensure_md_id_for_new_file now runs on every new-note registration (scanner pass 2 and register_single_file). Grep shows no other caller, so the reach matches I14.; The search cache (readSearchCache, keyed by query text) can show a relative modified: result computed at an earlier now until revalidation completes. The spec accepts this ('the search cache keys by the query text').; ResolvedModified.hasAbsolute is computed but the route recomputes the absolute check on its own; nothing reads the field.
In the intelligence addon's Ask scope, a modified: token is now parsed as an operator and silently left out of the scope and the count. Before this change it was free text, which was also dropped.
